theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks to Fall as Fed Keeps Rates on Hold: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were set to track Wall Street lower after renewed concerns over artificial intelligence spending and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s policy outlook sent longer-dated Treasury yields to their highest levels in almost two decades.

top_news.title: Stocks Fall as 30-Year Bond Yields Surge After Fed | The Close 7/29/2026
top_news.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Ken Shinoda, DoubleLine Capital Portfolio Manager, Alexandra Wilson-Elizondo, Goldman Sachs Global Co-Head of Multi-Asset Solutions, Rishi Jaluria, RBC Capital Markets Managing Director of Software Equity Research, Ygal Arounian, Wedbush Managing Director of Internet Equity Research, Abby Roach, Allspring Global Investments

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 30
top_news.summary: Oil steadied after its biggest daily jump in more than two weeks, as President Donald Trump vowed fresh strikes in Iran and US stockpiles fell.

top_news.title: Goldman-Backed Biotech Attovia Seeks $212.5 Million in US IPO
top_news.summary: Attovia Therapeutics Inc., an early-stage drug developer focused on immune-mediated diseases with high unmet need, is seeking to raise as much as $212.5 million in a US initial public offering.

top_news.title: Stocks Fall as 30-Year Bond Yields Surge After Fed: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks ended sharply lower as concerns about inflation drove longer-dated bond yields to an almost two-decade high after the Federal Reserve left rates steady despite a resurgence in oil prices.

top_news.title: Nothing Nefarious With 'Circle Financing': Dorrell
top_news.summary:
Mike Dorrell, chairman CEO and co-founder, Stonepeak joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Nvidia is working on a fresh round of AI deals worth more than $750 billion, accelerating investments that skeptics have warned are artificially inflating demand and valuations across the industry. Such transactions have left many AI companies increasingly intertwined, potentially exposing the sector to systemic shocks.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: FIFA Working On Plan To Raise As Much As $4.2B
top_news.summary:
Bloomberg's Vanessa Perdomo joins Dani Burger and Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." when FIFA announced controversial plans to raise external investment of $4.2 billion. In response to the proposal, UEFA, the organizer of European football, reacted furiously and saying it's considering a boycott of FIFA events. Also a top EU official saying today the FIFA proposal may spark competition law concerns.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Gold Trims Gain as Fed Holds Rates, Signals Hike Support
top_news.summary: Gold pared gains after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged as expected, while signaling that support for higher borrowing costs is growing as officials assess the inflationary impact of the Iran war.

top_news.title: Investment Committee: Consumer Brands & Spending Habits
top_news.summary: Enna Weng, head of capital markets at China Renaissance Global Markets, Eva Davis, managing partner, external affairs at Winston Taylor, and Tricia Glynn, managing partner at Advent International, join Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Apollo's Slok Says Warsh Silence Fuels Treasury Selloff
top_news.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's decision to abandon forward guidance on monetary policy is driving bond market volatility, with 30-year Treasuries selling off after Wednesday's rate decision, according to Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management. He speaks on Bloomberg Television's "The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)
